og_title: Face the Truth: Li Huowang’s Past is Swapped, Not Remembered
og_description: Can a hallucination become real? As Li Huowang unlocks a terrible memory, Zhuge Yuan proposes a theory of swapped history that changes everything.
twitter_title: Li Huowang = Hong Zhong? The Shocking Truth Revealed!
twitter_description: This chapter drops a bomb on the entire reality of Dao Guai Yi Xian. Li Huowang finds proof he was a Zuowandao, but all is not as it seems.

lore_anchors.definition: The fundamental creative force of the universe in Daoist cosmology; in this novel, it is the power source of a Heart-Element, capable of making beliefs and hallucinations real.
A rare individual whose existence is anchored to a specific reality or region, making them a natural anchor of truth; a Heart-Element's power cannot create or replace a Heart-Pivot.
The Red Center mahjong tile; the title for a high-ranking member of the Zuowandao, and the identity Li Huowang fears he truly possesses.
The Mother of the Big Dipper, a high Daoist deity; in this novel, she is a Siming who controls aspects of truth and falsehood, and her origin is tied to the same Primordial One Qi.
A theory that an entire historical timeline (Great Qi ruling the world) was not erased but swapped with a false one (the divided Liang), implying pasts can be exchanged, not just forgotten.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a person whose soul is a physical 'pivot' or anchor for a specific piece of reality, making them a point of absolute truth that a Heart-Element's power to create falsehoods cannot easily overwrite.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Li Huowang believe he was Hong Zhong?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He discovered a secret agent he planted six years ago as Hong Zhong, complete with a hidden, inscribed mahjong tile, providing what seemed like irrefutable physical evidence of his identity.

He believes Li Huowang's past was *swapped* with another version of history, just like the true history of Great Qi was swapped with the false one of Great Liang, making the memories false artifacts, not a true origin.
